sheet_id.description: Id of the sheet the trigger belongs to (added by the connector).

conditionField.description: Column key the condition is evaluated on.

conditionType.description: e.g. equals, contains, is empty, is greater than, matches regex, exists in.

actionType.description: e.g. show, hide, set value, notify me, play sound, move row, copy row.

notifyMethod.description: email, in app notification or in app dialog.

toSheet.description: Destination sheet id for move row / copy row actions.
